import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(sym):
 p=f'../persistent/stock_data/{sym}.csv'; return pd.read_csv(p,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close']
dxy=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close']
px=pd.concat([load(s).rename(s) for s in U]+[dxy.rename('DXY')],axis=1).sort_index()
r=px.pct_change(); dr=r.DXY
# defensive dollar-beta: negative 60d covariance beta (higher = less positive/USD-sensitive)
beta=r[U].rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(dr).div(dr.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var(),axis=0)
f=-beta
fwd=px[U].pct_change().shift(-1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 x=f.loc[dt]; y=fwd.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
print('dates',len(a),'avg_n',a.n.mean(),'coverage',a.n.sum()/(len(a)*15))
print('daily IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(a.ic.mean(),a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(),(a.ic>0).mean()))
for h in [5,10]:
 fw=px[U].pct_change(h).shift(-h); q=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=pd.Series(q);print(h,'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std()),'n',len(q))
for a0,b in [('2020','2022'),('2023','2024'),('2025','2026')]:
 q=a.loc[a.index.to_period('Y').astype(str).between(a0,b)].ic;print(a0,b,'mean',q.mean(),'icir',q.mean()/q.std(),'n',len(q))
# rank turnover
ranks=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',ranks.diff().abs().mean().mean())
print('recent',a.tail(250).ic.mean(),a.tail(250).ic.mean()/a.tail(250).ic.std())
# signal artifacts
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20260730_dxy_beta_signal.csv')
